tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find individual tools by name and description (as the servers report them in tools/list), with the server each belongs to and its measurements. Example: q='pdf table extraction'.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Registry data, latest measurements, declared risk, rank parts, connection URLs and tools of one server.

tools.name: get_server_history
tools.description: Daily check results (reachable, response time) of one server for up to 30 days.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Tools added or removed, input schema changes, new destructive tools, servers that stopped or started answering, and new listings, per day for the last 30 days. Give names to watch specific servers.

tools.name: check_overlap
tools.description: Give the exact registry names of the MCP servers you connect (or plan to). Returns which of them share tool definitions, a remote endpoint or a registry description, compared on the same measurement day, and how many other listings share each one's tool definitions. tools.name: list_categories

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_server · Private data: search_servers · Public sink: check_overlap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_server · Private data: search_servers · Public sink: check_overlap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
